commit 5089b0d319207ce1ef436b9c97f1bf801ff55a4c
Author: ddx-checkpoint <checkpoint@ddx.local>
Date:   Fri May 29 02:35:32 2026 -0400

    fix(routing): include available subscription-harness tiers in unfiltered ListModels [fizeau-6506be18]
    
    When the configured providers block is unreachable (or empty) but
    subscription CLI harnesses (claude/codex/gemini) are available on PATH,
    ListModels(ModelFilter{}) returned zero models, emptying the caller's
    power-escalation ladder and producing "no viable routing floor".
    
    Root cause: unfiltered ListModels assembled models only from the provider
    snapshot; subscription-harness tiers were returned only when filter.Harness
    was set (the listModelsForSubprocessHarness path).
    
    Fix: extract the per-harness tier-building loop into a reusable helper
    service.subscriptionHarnessTierModels(name, cfg, cat) and call it from both
    the harness-pinned path and the unfiltered path. The unfiltered path now
    enumerates registry.Discover() and appends tiers for every available
    subprocess subscription harness (excluding fiz, HTTP providers, TestOnly,
    and in-process harnesses), honoring filter.Provider and deduping against
    provider-backed output. Filtered-by-harness behavior and scoring are
    unchanged.
    
    subprocessHarnessModelIDs is now a package-level var so tests can inject a
    hermetic model surface without launching real CLIs via PTY. newTestService
    defaults registry.LookPath to report no subprocess binaries so harness
    discovery is hermetic regardless of installed CLIs.
    
    Tests: TestListModelsUnfilteredIncludesAvailableSubscriptionTiers,
    TestListModelsFilteredByHarnessUnchanged.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

3	// This file implements ListModels for the FizeauService service.

6	//
7	// Provider-backed models are assembled from the unified model snapshot used by

20		"github.com/easel/fizeau/internal/serviceimpl"
21	)
22	
23	// ListModels returns models matching the filter, with full metadata.
24	// Empty filter returns all models from every reachable provider.
25	func (s *service) ListModels(ctx context.Context, filter ModelFilter) ([]ModelInfo, error) {
26		if filter.Harness != "" && harnesses.ResolveHarnessAlias(filter.Harness) != "fiz" {
27			return s.listModelsForSubprocessHarness(filter), nil
28		}
29	
30		sc := s.opts.ServiceConfig
31		if sc == nil {
32			return nil, fmt.Errorf("service: no ServiceConfig provided; pass ServiceOptions.ServiceConfig")
33		}
34	
35		// Load the model catalog once for cross-referencing.
36		cat, _ := modelcatalog.Default() // ignore error: catalog miss is non-fatal
37		cacheRoot, err := serviceSnapshotCacheRoot()
38		if err != nil {
39			return nil, err
40		}
41		snapshot, err := assembleModelSnapshotFromServiceConfigWithOptions(ctx, sc, cat, cacheRoot, modelsnapshot.AssembleOptions{Refresh: modelsnapshot.RefreshForce})
42		if err != nil {
43			return nil, err
44		}
45		out := s.listModelsFromSnapshot(ctx, sc, cat, snapshot, filter)
46		// Provider-backed models come only from the configured providers block. When
47		// those endpoints are unreachable (or none are configured) the snapshot is
48		// empty, which would leave callers with no routing floor even though
49		// subscription CLI harnesses (claude/codex/gemini) may be available on PATH.
50		// Append the available subscription-harness tiers so the unfiltered inventory
51		// always reflects every reachable surface.
52		out = append(out, s.availableSubscriptionHarnessModels(filter, out)...)
53		return out, nil
54	}
55	
56	// availableSubscriptionHarnessModels enumerates the subprocess subscription
57	// harnesses (claude/codex/gemini etc.) that are available on the system and
58	// returns their tier ModelInfos. It honors filter.Provider, excludes the
59	// embedded "fiz" harness, HTTP-only providers, and test-only harnesses, and
60	// dedups against harnesses already represented in the provider-backed output.
